cohort: Pregnant multiparous women who experienced elevated maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein (MSAFP) levels during an initial and a subsequent pregnancy.
finding: Among multiparous women, 7.8% with initial elevated MSAFP had recurrent elevated MSAFP in a subsequent pregnancy, which was associated with adverse outcomes including fetal growth restriction, pre-eclampsia, preterm births, and fetal death/miscarriage.
